The '''Gargolyn monster''' was a huge creature native to [[Gargolyn IV]]. It once terrorized a [[Cor]] village until a [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] bound it to the land. This act remained effective as long as Cor remained on that location; however, the [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]] forcibly relocated the tribe causing the beast to re-emerge and attack their construction site. Once the Cor tribe was returned to their tribal lands, the beast was able to be subdued.
